step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture represents an automated, multi-tenant CI/CD pipeline built on AWS. It uses AWS CodePipeline to orchestrate the entire process. The flow starts with a Developer committing code to AWS CodeCommit, which automatically triggers a build via AWS CodeBuild. AWS CodeBuild outputs the container image to Amazon Elastic Container Registry (ECR). For deployment, rather than just updating the task definition directly, AWS CloudFormation is triggered. This allows infrastructure-as-code to manage not only the Amazon ECS deployment but also dependent resources like the Elastic Load Balancing (ALB) and AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) configurations. The process implements a strict governance model using CloudFormation Change Sets, manual Approval, and Execution before deploying changes across multiple target VPCs representing up to 100 parallel tenant environments.

graph.name: Multi-Tenant CI/CD Pipeline and Automated Infrastructure Deployment
graph.notes: Automates both application builds and core networking/IAM infrastructure deployments per tenant VPC using a 3-step CloudFormation governance workflow (Change Set, Approve, Execute) orchestrated by AWS CodePipeline.

nodes.name: Developer
nodes.notes: Initiates pipeline by committing code modifications to the repository.

nodes.name: AWS CodePipeline
nodes.notes: Orchestrates the continuous integration and continuous deployment pipeline stages.

nodes.name: AWS CodeCommit
nodes.notes: AWS Git repository hosting the application code and CloudFormation templates.

nodes.name: AWS CodeBuild
nodes.notes: Serverless build service that compiles code, runs tests, and packages container images.

nodes.name: Amazon Elastic Container Registry
nodes.notes: Stores versioned container images generated by the CodeBuild process.

nodes.name: AWS CloudFormation
nodes.notes: Applies changes across environments using parallel execution, operating with a Change Set -> Approve -> Execute flow.

nodes.name: Amazon Virtual Private Cloud
nodes.notes: Isolated network environment hosting the production and customer-specific resources.

nodes.name: Amazon Elastic Container Service
nodes.notes: Runs the core containerized application tasks within the VPC.

nodes.name: AWS Identity and Access Management
nodes.notes: Defines application and runtime roles deployed and managed alongside the infrastructure.

nodes.name: Elastic Load Balancing
nodes.notes: Application Load Balancer (ALB) routing external traffic to ECS tasks.

edges.notes: Developer commits application and CloudFormation code modifications to CodeCommit.
CodePipeline detects commit changes in AWS CodeCommit and triggers execution.
Source files and code are sent to AWS CodeBuild.
CodeBuild builds the Docker image and pushes it to Amazon ECR registry.
CodePipeline transitions to the deployment stage, initiating the AWS CloudFormation workflow.
CloudFormation deploys and provisions parallel resources into target VPCs using tenant-specific templates.
Deploys or updates Amazon ECS services and task definitions using images from ECR.
Deploys/manages necessary IAM policies and service execution roles.
Configures and routes target groups on the Application Load Balancer.
